title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.21228v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. translated_title: FOCAL-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的子任务引导几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模
translated_abstract: 基于预训练视觉-语言模型构建的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多样化的机器人操作任务中展现出了强大的性能。然而，直接将当前2D观测映射为动作的VLA模型往往缺乏充分的空间和时间理解能力，这限制了其在精确操作和长时程操作任务中的表现。近期的方法通过对整个场景进行几何监督和未来状态预测来增强VLA模型。然而，这些方法可能受到冗余场景信息的干扰，使模型难以专注于学习与当前交互相关的几何和动力学信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FOCAL-VLA，这是一个将子任务引导的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模相结合的框架，用于学习当前空间结构和未来交互动力学的表示。为使几何学习聚焦于当前子任务，我们迁移几何知识（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FOCAL-VLA框架，通过子任务引导的几何蒸馏使几何学习聚焦于当前交互相关的空间结构，并结合隐式世界建模预测未来交互动力学，从而提升VLA模型在精确和长时程机器人操作任务中的空间与时间理解能力。
en_tdlr: FOCAL-VLA combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to focus geometric learning on task-relevant spatial structures and predict future interaction dynamics, enhancing spatial-temporal understanding for precise, long-horizon robotic manipulation.
